goals: Verify the successful execution of the simulated user flow for post interactions.
Ensure all API requests within the user flow (get, create, comment, view, like posts) return a 200 OK status.
activities: Perform a GET request to retrieve posts.
Verify the GET posts request returns a 200 status.
Record the duration of the GET posts request.
Pause the execution.
Perform a POST request to create a new post.
Verify the POST create post request returns a 200 status, failing if it does not.
Record the duration of the POST create post request.
Extract the ID of the newly created post from the response body.
Pause the execution.
Perform a POST request to create a comment for the new post.
Verify the POST create comment request returns a 200 status.
Record the duration of the POST create comment request.
Pause the execution.
Perform a PUT request to increment the view count for the post.
Verify the PUT view post request returns a 200 status.
Record the duration of the PUT view post request.
Pause the execution.
Perform a PUT request to like the post.
Verify the PUT like post request returns a 200 status.
Record the duration of the PUT like post request.
